reviews.title: One of the best mobile games
reviews.text: I love games like Mythic Heroes, I’ve been in a hate/love type relationship with this game thoo. On one hand, Mythic Heroes easily outclasses its competitors with its plethora of characters, the game has been out for a while but with updates it makes it feel fresh, and a boatload of content. But on the other side, I don’t know if other players experience this as often as I have but I’ll be playing and something like summoning my heroes, completing the pantheon trials and there are more, the game freezes then it’ll close itself out. I can’t tell you how many times I’ve uninstalled and reinstalled this game! I can’t seem to get away from it but I would like this to be patched if possible please.
